title: Lathe Works — 3D Turning Studio
description: Draw a profile curve, spin it into a real 3D solid, then walk away with an OBJ or STL you can actually open.
concept: A virtual woodturner's lathe in the browser. You shape a silhouette by dragging nodes on a 2D profile editor; every move re-revolves the curve into a live indexed WebGL mesh with smooth or faceted normals. Twist, taper, bulge and flute sliders turn a plain vase into a barley-twist column or a fluted Greek urn, and a partial sweep with capped flanks gives you a cutaway. The exports are the point: real .obj geometry with normals for Blender or three.js, a binary .stl for a slicer, a composited .png render, plus JSON projects and share links.
features: Node-based profile editor — move, add and delete nodes on a Catmull-Rom or linear silhouette, with undo, relax and flip
Live lathe engine — segments, rings and sweep angle rebuild an indexed mesh every frame you touch a control
Deform stack — twist (barley spiral), taper, sinusoidal bulge, and radial fluting with adjustable depth
5 shading models (Glazed, Clay, Metal, Toon, Normals), 10 colours, movable key light, gloss and rim controls
Orbit / pinch-zoom / two-finger pan camera with auto-spin, wireframe lattice and half-section cutaway
Export real geometry: .obj with vertex normals, binary .stl for 3D printing, composited .png render
8 turned presets plus a Surprise generator that relaxes random profiles into plausible turnings
Workshop shelf — named localStorage saves, .json project export/import, and btoa share links
tech: GLSL vertex + fragment shaders (5 material branches, gl_FrontFacing, discard cutaway)
Hand-rolled perspective / lookAt / rotation matrix math
Indexed lathe mesh generation with seam-shared vertices and accumulated smooth normals
Canvas 2D profile editor with devicePixelRatio scaling
Pointer Events (orbit drag, pinch zoom, two-finger pan, node drag)

interaction.mouse: Drag the stage to orbit the turning; scroll to dolly in and out; drag nodes on the profile canvas to reshape the silhouette.
interaction.click: Tap presets, materials and colours; use Add/Delete tools to insert or remove profile nodes; toggle wireframe, cutaway and auto-spin from the view bar.
interaction.touch: One finger orbits, two fingers pinch-zoom and pan; the profile editor takes direct taps and drags; panel scrolls independently of the stage.
interaction.keyboard: W wireframe · H half-section · R reset camera · Space auto-spin · E export OBJ · Ctrl/Cmd+Z undo profile edit
